name: brdcomp-select
title: Select
description: A custom select dropdown for choosing a single option, with groups and labels. Similar to Dropdown Menu but for selection.

examples.title: Select options
examples.code:
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger>
    <SelectValue placeholder="Pick one" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="a">Option A</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="b">Option B</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
